name: Jezero Crater, Mars
description: Perseverance's field site: delta, crater floor and western rim. HiRISE 1 m DTMs over the rover traverse, CTX 20 m DEM over the whole crater.

name: New hub (3.144N, 155.311E)
description: Generated by MarsNav from real data: MOLA MEGDR 128 ppd (463 m): 100 %; CTX stereo DTM 20 m: 47 %; CTX orthoimage mosaic (6 m, resampled to 5 m): 24 %. Operations area DEM is 463 m: walking-scale slopes use a calibration from Jezero's 1 m data degraded to this resolution; boulders and scarps smaller than the DEM are not in the map (low confidence).

name: Mount Sharp boxwork, Gale crater
description: Curiosity's boxwork campaign on Mount Sharp, Gale crater (2025-2026): the challenge's own example. Built by MarsNav from 5 HiRISE 1 m DTMs (94 % of the operations area) and CTX 20 m DTMs. Hub: a forward camp (pressurised rover) at Curiosity's sol 4530 stop; stations at the Altadena, Monte Grande (Valle de la Luna / Nevado Sajama) and Campo Marte drill sites, placed at the rover's own localisations. Cliff-bounded buttes and 39 % sand: with dead-reckoning navigation much of it is out of reach.

name: Jezero Crater east floor, Mars (CTX-only test site)
description: Portability test: an area with no 1 m DTM coverage, built only from the 20 m CTX DEM. Proves the pipeline and engine run on any site with a DEM; confidence and soft-soil uncertainty reflect the coarser data.
